max_messages.description: Maximum number of messages allowed per user/client within the time window.

window.description: Time window in seconds during which max_messages is enforced.

debug.description: Enable verbose debug logging to syslog.

log_level.description: Syslog priority level for logging (emerg, alert, crit, error, warning, notice, info, debug).

pid_file.description: Path to the PID file for the daemon.

listen_address.description: IP address to bind the policy service (typically loopback for Postfix integration).

listen_port.description: TCP port for the policy service (used only if Postfix connects via inet, otherwise unix socket).

storage_backend.description: Backend for storing counters: 'memory' (fast, non-persistent), 'sqlite' (simple, persistent), or 'redis' (distributed).

sqlite_database.description: Path to SQLite database file (used only if storage_backend = 'sqlite').

redis_url.description: Redis connection string (used only if storage_backend = 'redis').

scope.description: Scope of rate limit: 'user' (auth user), 'sender' (envelope sender), or 'client' (client IP).

ignore_clients.description: List of CIDR ranges for clients to exempt from rate limiting.

ignore_users.description: List of regex patterns for users to exempt (e.g., system accounts).

ignore_domains.description: List of regex patterns for domains to exempt (e.g., internal relay).

custom_limits.description: List of per-sender rate limit overrides. Each entry has a sender pattern and custom limit.

sender_pattern.description: Envelope sender address or regex pattern (e.g., noreply@example.com)

rate_limit.description: Custom max messages allowed for this sender within the window.

action_on_limit.description: Action when rate limit exceeded: 'reject' (554) or 'warn' (log and allow).

reject_message.default: 554 5.7.1 User exceeded rate limit of %n messages per %w seconds

burst_enabled.description: Enable temporary burst allowance (allows short spikes up to burst_limit).

burst_limit.description: Maximum burst allowed when burst_enabled is true (must be > max_messages).

session_reset_timeout.description: Seconds of inactivity before resetting per-session counters.

max_sessions.description: Maximum number of concurrent tracked sessions (0 = unlimited).

redis_sync_interval.description: Seconds between Redis syncs (only applicable for Redis backend).
